verdict_detail: median verbatim share 15.5 bp against real held-out 55.0 bp and uniform chance 15.0 bp. NOT copying -- but also no more verbatim overlap with the corpus than random sequence has, so the generator has not captured the shared motif/paralogue content that makes real promoters resemble a promoter corpus. Report both facts.

verdict_recomputed.why: The first label came from a knife-edge state-3 test (generated <= uniform). These are integer-valued medians, so generated 15.5 vs uniform 15.0 -- half a base -- decided which of two QUALITATIVELY different states was reported. The test now asks where generated sits in the uniform->real RANGE; within its bottom quarter is at-chance in any useful sense. Numbers unchanged; only the label is recomputed.
